meters.title: Own meters (optional)
meters.description: Has your gateway no CTs? Link your own meters (for example a Shelly on the solar group, a Shelly 3EM or a P1 meter). The integration then creates the same entities as with CTs: production, consumption, grid import and export, self-consumption and self-sufficiency, and a live estimate per panel. Leave empty what you do not have. Link only the power sensor of a meter: its voltage, current, power factor, apparent and reactive power and frequency are found on the same device by themselves, so the grid card, cos φ and the beer glass work as with Enphase CTs. A single-phase meter is fine.

data_description.ext_production_power: A power sensor (W or kW) that measures your solar panels, e.g. a Shelly Pro EM on the solar group.
data_description.ext_grid_power: Power at your main connection. Leave empty when you link the three phases below.
data_description.ext_grid_import: Lifetime counter in kWh, e.g. from a P1 meter or Shelly 3EM.
data_description.ext_production_sign: Most meters show solar production as positive; some Shelly installations show it as negative.
data_description.ext_grid_sign: Most P1 meters and Shellys show export as negative (import positive). Choose positive if your meter does it the other way round.

data_description.underperform_threshold: A panel is flagged when it produces less than this percentage of what the good panels on the same roof surface produce (100 % = as good as the best panels).
data_description.forecast: Expected production per roof surface from the Open-Meteo weather forecast (free, no account; the Home Assistant location is sent). Calibrated automatically on what your panels really produce.
data_description.live_estimate: Microinverters report about every 15 minutes. With this on, every panel also gets a live value: its share of the last reports times what the production meter measures now (every 10 s).

inverter_underperforming.title: Panel {serial} produces less than its neighbours
inverter_underperforming.description: Microinverter {serial} ({where}) produced {performance}% of what the good panels on the same roof surface produce. Check for shade, dirt or damage. This notice disappears by itself when it recovers.

inverter_no_output.title: Panel {serial} produces nothing
inverter_no_output.description: Microinverter {serial} ({where}) has given no output for more than 30 minutes while the other panels on the same roof surface are producing. Check the inverter, its connector and the panel.

cloud_offline.title: Gateway {serial} has no connection with Enlighten
cloud_offline.description: The gateway has not reported to Enlighten for more than 6 hours. Local readings keep working, but Enlighten and firmware updates do not. Check its network connection.
